ucs.title: [LLM] Andariel/Onyx Sleet: web-app exploitation (Log4Shell, ManageEngine, Confluence) followed by LOLBin payload pull
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Andariel/Silent Chollima initial-access chain: exploitation of an internet-facing Java/.NET application (Log4Shell CVE-2021-44228, ManageEngine ServiceDesk CVE-2022-47966, Atlassian Confluence CVE-2022-26134) where the web/app server process spawns a Windows shell or LOLBin that immediately stages a second-stage implant (TigerRAT, Dtrack, MagicRAT, YamaBot, BlindingCan). Microsoft tracks this cluster as Onyx Sleet/PLUTONIUM; CrowdStrike calls it Silent Chollima.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_hash) as hash values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("java.exe","javaw.exe","tomcat*.exe","w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","ManageEngine*.exe","servicedesk*.exe","confluence*.exe","jira*.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","wmic.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") AND (Processes.process IN ("*http*","*DownloadString*","*DownloadFile*","*Invoke-WebRequest*","*IEX*","*-EncodedCommand*","*-enc *","*urlcache*","*decode*","*FromBase64String*") OR Processes.process IN ("*\\Temp\\*.exe","*\\ProgramData\\*.exe","*\\Public\\*.exe","*.dll,*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
// Andariel/Onyx Sleet: webapp/Java parent spawning shell+download — initial access via Log4Shell / ManageEngine / Confluence
let WebParents = dynamic(["java.exe","javaw.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","w3wp.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","servicedesk.exe","manageengine.exe","confluence.exe","jira.exe"]);
let ShellChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","wmic.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (WebParents)
| where FileName in~ (ShellChildren)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","urlcache","FromBase64String","certutil -decode","bitsadmin /transfer")
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\(Temp|ProgramData|Public|Users\\Public)\\[^\s]+\.(exe|dll|ps1|js|vbs|hta)"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

let ShellChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","wmic.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ChildName  = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ParentName in~ (WebParents)
| where ChildName in~ (ShellChildren)
| where CommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","DownloadString","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","IEX","Invoke-Expression","-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","urlcache","FromBase64String","certutil -decode","bitsadmin /transfer")
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\(Temp|ProgramData|Public|Users\\Public)\\[^\s]+\.(exe|dll|ps1|js|vbs|hta)"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TargetUserName, IpAddress
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Andariel/Onyx Sleet Web-App Exploitation Followed by LOLBin Payload Pull
id: 8c4f1c41-9b9c-4c4e-92a5-1f6a3b8d9e2a
status: experimental
description: Detects Andariel/Silent Chollima post-exploitation tradecraft where an internet-facing Java or web application server spawns a Windows shell/LOLBin that immediately downloads or decodes a second-stage payload (TigerRAT, Dtrack, MagicRAT, YamaBot). Covers Log4Shell, ManageEngine ServiceDesk (CVE-2022-47966) and Confluence (CVE-2022-26134) entry vectors.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/18/multiple-north-korean-threat-actors-exploiting-the-teamcity-cve-2023-42793-vulnerability/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0138/
author: SOC detection engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.g0138
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_webapp:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\tomcat.exe'
      - '\tomcat9.exe'
      - '\tomcat10.exe'
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
      - '\servicedesk.exe'
      - '\confluence.exe'
      - '\jira.exe'
  child_shell_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  download_or_encoded:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'certutil -decode'
      - 'bitsadmin /transfer'
      - 'urlcache'
  condition: parent_webapp and child_shell_lolbin and download_or_encoded
falsepositives:
  - Application server build/update scripts using PowerShell legitimately
  - Tomcat-hosted admin tooling that shells out (rare; allowlist by service account)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon OR source:windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) @ParentImage:(*\java.exe OR *\javaw.exe OR *\Tomcat*.exe OR *\tomcat*.exe OR *\w3wp.exe OR *\httpd.exe OR *\nginx.exe OR *\ServiceDesk*.exe OR *\Confluence*.exe OR *\jira*.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CertUtil.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe) @CommandLine:(*DownloadString* OR *DownloadFile* OR *Invoke-WebRequest* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *-enc\ * OR *FromBase64String* OR *http\:* OR *https\:* OR *certutil*decode* OR *bitsadmin*transfer* OR *urlcache*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(java|javaw|tomcat\d*|w3wp|httpd|nginx|servicedesk|manageengine|confluence|jira)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|certutil|bitsadmin|curl|regsvr32|mshta|rundll32|wmic|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(DownloadString|DownloadFile|Invoke-WebRequest|-EncodedCommand|-enc |FromBase64String|http://|https://|certutil.*decode|bitsadmin.*transfer|urlcache|\\\\(Temp|ProgramData|Public)\\\\)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData])])
ucs.rationale: Andariel/Onyx Sleet is repeatedly attributed (Microsoft 2022/2023, KISA, Mandiant) to exploitation of internet-facing Java/.NET enterprise apps — Log4Shell hits against Confluence/VMware Horizon, ManageEngine ServiceDesk CVE-2022-47966 against US healthcare and DIB, and Confluence CVE-2022-26134 — followed within seconds by spawning powershell/certutil/regsvr32 to stage TigerRAT/Dtrack/MagicRAT/Ya

ucs.title: [LLM] Andariel/Silent Chollima: LSASS dumping (ProcDump/comsvcs MiniDump) chained to SMB admin-share lateral movement and service-based execution
ucs.description: Hunts the Andariel post-exploitation chain documented in CISA AA22-187A (Maui ransomware against US healthcare) and Mandiant/Kaspersky Dtrack reports: dumping LSASS with ProcDump or rundll32+comsvcs.dll MiniDump, then using the harvested credentials to pivot to peer hosts over SMB admin shares (ADMIN$/C$/IPC$) and execute via remote service creation (SCM/PsExec-style). Andariel reliably combines T1003.001 → T1021.002 → T1569.002 within a single intrusion.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","taskmgr.exe","sqldumper.exe") AND (Processes.process IN ("*lsass*","*MiniDump*","*comsvcs.dll*","*-ma *","*-mm *","*MiniDumpW*")) ) OR (Processes.process_name IN ("psexec.exe","psexesvc.exe","paexec.exe","smbexec.py") OR Processes.parent_process_name="services.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*\\ADMIN$\\*","*\\C$\\*","*\\PerfLogs\\*","*\\Windows\\Temp\\*.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | eventstats count as host_event_count by host | where host_event_count >= 2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
// Andariel/Silent Chollima: LSASS dump → SMB lateral movement → service exec — Maui/Dtrack tradecraft
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let LsassDumps = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","sqldumper.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("lsass","-ma ","-mm "))
         or (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("comsvcs.dll","MiniDump"))
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDumpWriteDump","Out-Minidump","Invoke-Mimikatz","sekurlsa::","lsadump::"))
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
              DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine, DumpImage = FolderPath;
let RemoteSvcExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "services.exe"
         or FileName in~ ("psexec.exe","psexesvc.exe","paexec.exe")
         or (InitiatingProcessParentFileName =~ "services.exe" and FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\(ADMIN\$|C\$|Windows\\Temp|PerfLogs|ProgramData)\\")
    | project SvcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              SvcCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SvcImage = FolderPath,
              SvcAccount = AccountName, SvcParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let AdminShareLogons = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | where LogonType in ("Network","NetworkCleartext")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project LogonTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
              RemoteIP, RemoteDeviceName, LogonType;
LsassDumps
| join kind=inner (AdminShareLogons) on AccountName
| where LogonTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + WindowMinutes)
| join kind=inner (RemoteSvcExec) on $left.RemoteDeviceName == $right.DeviceName
| where SvcTime between (LogonTime .. LogonTime + WindowMinutes)
| project DumpTime, DumpDevice = DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          DumpCmd, LogonTime, RemoteDeviceName, RemoteIP,
          SvcTime, SvcImage, SvcCmd, SvcParent
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Andariel/Silent Chollima — LSASS dump → SMB lateral → service exec
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let LsassDumps = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildName = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | where (ChildName in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","sqldumper.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("lsass","-ma ","-mm "))
         or (ChildName =~ "rundll32.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("comsvcs.dll","MiniDump"))
         or (ChildName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("MiniDumpWriteDump","Out-Minidump","Invoke-Mimikatz","sekurlsa::","lsadump::"))
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName, CommandLine;
let AdminShareLogons = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 3
    | where AccountType == "User" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | project LogonTime = TimeGenerated, TargetComputer = Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress, WorkstationName;
let RemoteSvcExec = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID in (4697, 7045)
    | project SvcTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ServiceName, ServiceFileName, SubjectUserName;
LsassDumps
| join kind=inner (AdminShareLogons) on $left.SubjectUserName == $right.TargetUserName
| where LogonTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + WindowMinutes)
| join kind=inner (RemoteSvcExec) on $left.TargetComputer == $right.Computer
| where SvcTime between (LogonTime .. LogonTime + WindowMinutes)
| project DumpTime, DumpHost = Computer, SubjectUserName, CommandLine,
          LogonTime, TargetComputer, IpAddress,
          SvcTime, ServiceName, ServiceFileName
| order by DumpTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon OR source:windows.security) ((@EventID:(1 OR 4688) AND ((@Image:(*\procdump.exe OR *\ProcDump.exe OR *\procdump64.exe OR *\Procdump64.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*lsass* OR *Lsass* OR *LSASS*)) OR (@Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*comsvcs.dll*MiniDump* OR *comsvcs.dll*minidump*)) OR (@Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*MiniDumpWriteDump* OR *Out-Minidump* OR *Invoke-Mimikatz* OR *sekurlsa\:\:* OR *lsadump\:\:*)))) OR (@EventID:(1 OR 4688) AND (@Image:(*\psexec.exe OR *\PsExec.exe OR *\psexesvc.exe OR *\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\paexec.exe) OR (@ParentImage:(*\services.exe OR *\Services.exe) AND @Image:(*\Windows\Temp\*.exe OR *\PerfLogs\*.exe OR *\ProgramData\*.exe)))) OR (@EventID:4624 AND @LogonType:3))
ucs.rationale: CISA AA22-187A explicitly documents Andariel's Maui ransomware operators dumping LSASS (ProcDump and rundll32 comsvcs.dll MiniDump variants) then pivoting via SMB admin shares + remote service creation in the same intrusion — the same chain Kaspersky and Mandiant document for Dtrack/TigerRAT campaigns against defense and finance verticals.
